URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Chel.]
Spasmodic pain in right kidney and in liver ; < from 4 to 9 P. M.
Shooting in region of kidneys and of bladder ; > lying on face.
Pain in region of kidneys, which are sensitive to pressure, even of clothing.
Tenderness in renal region. θ Bright's disease.
Violent pains in direction of ureters, preceding passage of turbid urine.
Violent paroxysms of pain in kidneys, with intense headache, vertigo and syncope. θ Nephritis.
Violent pain in hypogastrium and vesical region, not < by pressure. θ Liver complaint.
Stabbing pains in region of bladder.
Spasmodic pain just above os pubis, with frequent passing of urine.
Dragging pain in bladder, with spasmodic, trembling pains in inguinal region.
Discharge of pus from urethra. θ Gonorrhœa.
Cutting pain in urethra on urinating and continuing after urinating.
Burning in urethra on urinating. θ Gonorrhœa.
Strangury, lasting all day, with scanty urination.
Frequent call to pass water, which passes away without being obliged to urinate.
Frequent urging to urinate.
Urine : profuse, whitish, foaming ; red and turbid ; dark yellow, clear ; lemon yellow, turbid ; dark ; brownish-red ; green.
Urine turbid, acid, and yellow as gold. θ Typhus.
Urine bright yellow, clear and acid. θ Cough.
Urine bright and clear, or turbid, acid and reddish. θ Acute rheumatism.
Urine reddish, cloudy, with reddish, slimy sediment. θ Liver complaint.
Urine reddish, turbid, containing fibrin, flakes and sand. θ Nephritis.
Red urine. θ Laryngitis.
Urine red, cloudy, with a chalky sediment.
Urine smells acid or ammoniacal.
Urine has a resinous odor.
Diabetes mellitus.
   

MALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [22] [Chel.]
Frequent erections, even during day.
Drawing pain : in spermatic cords ; in testicles.
Sticking in urethra, especially towards orifice.
Pain in glans.
Itching and creeping on scrotum and glans.
Redness, heat and swelling of scrotum, with small, flat vesicles, painful to touch, they become moist, next day form dry scales.
Acne on male parts. θ Hemorrhoids.
Eczematous exanthemata on male parts and anus. θ Hemorrhoids.
Eczema rubrum on scrotum.
Painful swelling of right testicle, with tension and drawing in spermatic cord. θ Suppressed gonorrhœa.
Gonorrhœa and secondary syphilis, with ulcerated buboes.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Chel.]
Menses too late ; too profuse ; pain under right scapula.
Menses retarded, but continue longer than natural.
Amenorrhœa.
Burning in vagina, recurring each day at precisely the same hour.
Acrid leucorrhœa.
   

PREGNANCY. PARTURITION. LACTATION. [24] [Chel.]
Longing for unusual articles of food during pregnancy.
Milk diminished.
Secretion of milk grows less and less until it entirely ceases.
   

VOICE AND LARYNX. TRACHEA AND BRONCHIA. [25] [Chel.]
Hoarseness.
Voice weak. θ Erysipelas.
Spasm of glottis on expiration, with cough.
Spasm of glottis daily, with profuse perspiration at night.
Spasm of glottis during violent fits of coughing, with expectoration of mucus.
Pricking pain in larynx rendering loud speaking impossible.
While coughing, pain in larynx and sacrum.
Severe tickling in larynx.
Pressure on larynx, as if air could not pass through ; as if swollen ; more to the right.
Sticking pain in throat in region of larynx.
Shooting and burning in throat and larynx ; dull throbbing from congestion.
Constriction in trachea, deadly anguish ; desire for eructation.
Choking sensation in throat, < when breathing.
Sensation as if throat was constricted at larynx.
Sensation as if larynx was pressed back upon œsophagus, impeding swallowing.
Pressure or heat in trachea.
Irritation to cough in trachea.
Sensation of dust in trachea, throat, and behind sternum, not relieved by cough.
Capillary bronchitis.
